# AKIA Hand Made Soaps & Herbal Botanicals

> Pure Ayurvedic Cold-Cured Soaps & Artisan Botanicals Handcrafted in Kerala, India.

## About the Brand
AKIA is an artisan botanical atelier based in Kerala, India, specializing in authentic, small-batch Ayurvedic formulations. Every formulation is made using traditional cold-cured saponification, pure coconut oil, and wild-harvested botanicals without synthetic detergents, artificial hardeners, sulphates (SLS/SLES), or parabens.

## Core Product Offerings

### 1. Handcrafted Cold-Cured Soaps
- **Thulasi & Neem Purifying Soap**: Enriched with wild holy basil and cold-pressed coconut oil for clarifying acne-prone skin and natural antibacterial defense.
- **Rakta Chandana (Red Sandalwood) Radiance Soap**: Authentic red sandalwood paste formulated for hyperpigmentation, uneven skin tone, and natural radiance.
- **Nalpamaram Restorative Soap**: Traditional Kerala postpartum and restorative skincare blend made with four sacred ficus barks (Athi, Ithi, Arayal, Peral) for deep dermal rejuvenation.
- **Kasturi Manjal (Wild Turmeric) Glow Soap**: Non-staining aromatic wild turmeric for blemish control and complexion brightness.
- **Aloe Vera & Pure Vetiver (Ramacham) Cooling Soap**: Soothes sun-exposed, sensitive, and irritated skin with organic aloe pulp and cooling vetiver roots.

### 2. Intensive Herbal Hair Care
- **Brahmi & Bhringraj Scalp Revitalizing Hair Oil**: Slow-infused cold-pressed coconut oil enriched with Brahmi, Bhringraj, Amla, and Curry Leaves to strengthen hair follicles, prevent premature greying, and stimulate density.

### 3. Botanical Face & Body Essentials
- **Hydrating Aloe Vera & Cucumber Gels**: Multi-purpose soothing gels for skin hydration and post-sun therapy.
- **Gentle Herbal Face Washes**: Low-foaming, pH-balanced botanical washes without synthetic surfactant stripping.

---

## Brand Commitments & Standards
- **100% Free From**: Sulphates (SLS/SLES), Parabens, Mineral Oils, Synthetic Silicones, and Artificial Hardeners.
- **Process**: Traditional Cold-Process Curing for 4 to 6 weeks to retain natural botanical glycerin and active phytonutrients.
- **Cruelty-Free & Vegetarian**: Never tested on animals, ethically sourced Indian herbs.
